title: Complete CV1 body-knowledge and durable-discovery specification
head: ea998fa0e9d83c1bd2822cd9c5eb9bda27d90d32

reviews.classification: complete unselected projection specification with qualified evidence/persistence boundaries
reviews.disposition: Full F1a–F1n and D1–D6 review preserves CV1 as an unselected known-body projection on a supported existing status-card holder. It is not acquisition of a second dormant card, a hidden-fact scanner, a gene/concentration model or an automatic capability grant. The narrow proposed B2 observation adapter and biography are compatible consumers, not a general epistemology/registry requirement. Explicit holder/observer/body/world/clock/means binding and distinct enable/observation events remain necessary at the selected route; an unavailable B2 fallback is not the promised useful result. Keep admission before grouping/sorting/counting/deltas and evidence IDs internal to the adapter. Category/range/exact describes precision, seen/understood learning, and confidence/attribution certainty; none substitutes for the others. Two copies of a report are correlated evidence, an unsupported negative is not measured zero, and learned memory/access permission differ. Retain contradictory reading IDs and needed old bases without truth-based stale flags. Snapshot as-of, actual continuously supplied live reading, witnessed invalidation and public condition expiry need their own producers; render/hover cannot discover, consume or refresh them. Compare only compatible known body/model/unit/clock records. A finite sentinel/regex matrix can validate its selected boundary, not prove zero disclosure for every possible secret or new field. Preserve free durable enable on one detached envelope before install/reveal/focus and idempotent retry/restore. The old F1l generic render-before-save claim is qualified by B84/B110’s later generic host source; CV1’s own joined B2/lens validator, fault behavior and native route remain unverified. Optional nested extension/defaults do not prove whole envelope compatibility or old-reader downgrade safety. Retention/compaction may remove superseded inactive views only while preserving active inquiry evidence and dedupe identity. The 512-byte lens/4KiB body targets are engineering estimates, not caps or permission to truncate valid knowledge. Device tab preference has its own owner and cannot grant gameplay discovery. Keep real keyboard/focus/scroll, effects-off and current desktop/text targets; old 1366-only layout and 560px breakpoint are proposals, not universal gates. No CARDS body, UI implementation or new behavior was reviewed by this spec alone.
reviews.evidence: All 349 original lines read in four complete bounded spans, including exact schema, observation admission/order, UI semantics, compatibility and completion. Current generic-host evidence reused only at B84/B110 recorded scope; no original CARDS/source/browser claims expanded.
reviews.reopen: Only a selected actual body-lens route warrants current validator/producer/consumer, native fault, observer and literal persistence evidence. Preserve candidate choices without building or declaring acceptance.
